What Makes Lauhata Special?

  • The beach in front

    Dark sand, palm trees and open water, directly in front of the tables.

  • Restaurant and bar

    Breakfast, lunch and dinner facing the sea, from eggs and pancakes to grilled fish and pizza.

  • Sunsets over the water

    The sun goes down into the sea, in view of the beach and the tables.

  • Room to slow down

    Blue verandas, a garden, and the beach a few steps from your door.

  • Families and groups

    A room with a queen and a single bed, and a welcome for birthdays, family gatherings and group meals.

  • Timorese hospitality

    A local business, run by Carlos Soares and the team. In public reviews, the team is what guests mention most.

Around Lauhata

Lauhata is west of Dili, on the Liquiçá coast, between the sea and the mountains. Nearby there is history and culture to discover: Maubara fort, the ruins of Aipelo prison and the centre of Liquiçá.

Frequently asked questions

See all questions
How do I book a table or request a room?

Use the “Make a reservation” button at the top of any page, choose Restaurant or Stay, fill in the details and send the message that opens in WhatsApp. It is a request: nothing is reserved until the Lauhata team confirms it in that conversation.

How much is a room?

$90 a night, per room and not per person, for both room types. Send your dates and the team confirms availability on WhatsApp.

Is payment made online?

No. Payment is made in person at Lauhata. The website takes no payments and never asks for card details.

When is the restaurant open?

Breakfast 08:00–10:00 · Lunch & dinner 11:00–21:00. If you are planning a particular day, ask on WhatsApp first.

How do restaurant orders work? Is there takeaway or delivery?

Add dishes on the Restaurant page and send the order to the team on WhatsApp. Orders are for eating at the restaurant: there is no delivery or takeaway.
